description: PAID $0.005. Ranked Hyperliquid traders by window PnL with optional Thirdfy join. Research ranking, not a buy list. Returns a JSON ranking of Hyperliquid traders for the window, with Thirdfy agents joined only when requested.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

include_thirdfy.description: Whether to join Thirdfy agents into the ranking. Format: boolean true or false. Example: true. Omit for the server's current choice.

limit.description: Maximum rows. Format: positive integer. Example: 10. Omit for the server's current cap.

window.description: Ranking window. Format: a window name such as the week value used by top_traders. Example: week. Omit for the server's current window.

name: bots_top
title: Top HL traders + Thirdfy agents ($0.005)
